description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B via Ollama: compact vision-language model for local coding, reasoning and tool use.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b`. Download 7.2-7.9GB (7.52B (effective 4B, Gemma4 arch), Q4_K_M default tag), needs ~9GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 128K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). No independent benchmark found; Gemma 4 E4B architecture (carded 3.8), small bump for NVIDIA post-training. Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Thinking is on by default: pass think=false for fast answers. Only 2 days old at card time; latest tag is a 74B-A9B (25GB), not carded. Page checked 2026-10-25.
